scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:sync && bun run build:state
scripts.cf-typegen: bun run --cwd apps/web cf-typegen && bun run --cwd apps/sync cf-typegen && bun run --cwd apps/state cf-typegen
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply vista-dev --local --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:prod: bun run prepare:prod-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply vista-prod --remote --config apps/web/wrangler.prod.jsonc --env prod
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute vista-dev --local --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --file packages/db/seeds/dev.sql
scripts.deploy:prod: bun run db:migrate:prod && bun run deploy:prod:web && bun run deploy:prod:sync
scripts.deploy:prod:sync: bun run prepare:prod-config && bun run --cwd apps/sync deploy -- --config wrangler.prod.jsonc --env prod
scripts.deploy:prod:web: bun run prepare:prod-config && bun run --cwd apps/web deploy -- --config wrangler.prod.jsonc --env prod
scripts.precommit: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/db typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/plaid typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/household-state typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/state typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/sync typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
